<!-- capabilities: generated from the library -->

# tinyfly capabilities (v0.96.0)

Generated from the library itself: every name below is accepted, and names not listed are rejected (beat scripts, code panels and `checkTracks` say which name was probably meant).

**Timing.** JSON timelines and tracks are in milliseconds; the GSAP-style API (live.to, tf.timeline) takes seconds. Scene x grows right, y grows down, in px.

## Easings

Named: `linear`, `ease-in`, `ease-out`, `ease-in-out`, `ease-in-quad`, `ease-out-quad`, `ease-in-out-quad`, `ease-in-cubic`, `ease-out-cubic`, `ease-in-out-cubic`.

- cubic-bezier: `{ type: "cubic-bezier", points: [x1, y1, x2, y2] }`
- steps: `{ type: "steps", count, position?: start | end | none | both }`
- elastic: `{ type: "elastic", mode?: in | out | in-out, amplitude?, period? }`
- bounce: `{ type: "bounce", mode?: in | out | in-out }`
- back: `{ type: "back", mode?: in | out | in-out, overshoot? }`

## Track kinds

- **keyframe**: { id, target, property, keyframes: [{ time, value, easing? }] }: values between keys are interpolated (numbers, colours, paths)
- **spring**: { id, target, property, kind: "spring", spring: { from, to, stiffness?, damping?, mass?, velocity? }, delay? }: physics settle
- **inertia**: { id, target, property, kind: "inertia", inertia: { from, velocity, friction?, min?, max?, end? }, delay? }: a flick that slows (end snaps to a value or the nearest of a list)
- **motionPath**: { property: "motionPath", path, align? }: moves along an SVG path
- **text**: { property: "text", … }: types or scrambles text

## Canvas targets

Types: `rect`, `circle`, `text`, `line`, `path`, `image`, `custom`. `describeTarget(target)` lists what one can animate with its values; `checkTracks(tracks, targets)` checks tracks before playing them.

| Property | Unit | What it does | Types |
|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | px | Moves it right by this much from where it was placed (an offset; the target’s own x is its place) | all |
| `y` | px | Moves it down by this much from where it was placed (an offset) | all |
| `opacity` | 0..1 | How opaque it is | all |
| `rotate` | degrees | Turns it clockwise about its origin | all |
| `rotateX` | degrees | Tips it about the horizontal axis (3D; shows with perspective) | all |
| `rotateY` | degrees | Turns it about the vertical axis (3D; shows with perspective) | all |
| `z` | px | Depth toward the viewer (shows with perspective) | all |
| `perspective` | px | Distance from the viewer: nearer parts grow, further ones shrink | all |
| `scale` | factor | Size, both ways | all |
| `scaleX` | factor | Width factor | all |
| `scaleY` | factor | Height factor | all |
| `skewX` | degrees | Slants it sideways | all |
| `skewY` | degrees | Slants it up and down | all |
| `originX` | % (0 left, 50 centre, 100 right) | Transform pivot across its box | all |
| `originY` | % (0 top, 50 centre, 100 bottom) | Transform pivot down its box | all |
| `fill` | color | Fill colour (also written fillStyle) | all |
| `stroke` | color | Outline colour (also written strokeStyle) | all |
| `strokeWidth` | px | Outline width (also written lineWidth) | all |
| `clipTop` | % of its height | Hides this much from the top edge, for reveals | all |
| `clipRight` | % of its width | Hides this much from the right edge | all |
| `clipBottom` | % of its height | Hides this much from the bottom edge | all |
| `clipLeft` | % of its width | Hides this much from the left edge | all |
| `blur` | px | Gaussian blur | all |
| `brightness` | factor | Brightness factor (1 unchanged) | all |
| `glow` | px | Soft glow around it, in glowColor | all |
| `glowColor` | color | Colour of the glow | all |
| `shadowX` | px | Drop shadow offset right | all |
| `shadowY` | px | Drop shadow offset down | all |
| `shadowBlur` | px | Drop shadow softness | all |
| `shadowColor` | color | Drop shadow colour | all |
| `shine` | 0..1 (progress) | A highlight sweeping across the fill | all |
| `drawOn` | 0..1 | How much of the outline is drawn, for drawing a shape on; the fill appears when it is complete | rect, circle, line, path |
| `width` | px | Box width | rect, image |
| `height` | px | Box height | rect, image |
| `borderRadius` | px | Rounded corners | rect, image |
| `radius` | px | Circle radius | circle |
| `x2` | px | Line end, x | line |
| `y2` | px | Line end, y | line |
| `d` | string | SVG path data; tween between paths to morph | path |
| `text` | string | The text shown (a text track types or scrambles it) | text |
| `fontSize` | px | Font size | text |
| `fontWeight` | 100..900 | Font weight | text |
| `motionPath` | string | Moves it along an SVG path (a motion-path track writes motionPathX/Y and, aligned, rotate) | all |
| `quaternion` | list | A rotation as [x, y, z, w] (a track with interpolation: "slerp") | all |

## Stick figure (`@algorisys/tinyfly/characters`)

`stickFigureTarget({ x, y, style })` is a custom canvas target; its props are the pose fields and the props below. Pose it with tracks (`poseTracks`), or write beats (`scriptTracks`).

### Pose fields

| Field | Unit | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `lean` | degrees | Upper body tipped about the hips (+ toward the way it faces) |
| `bend` | degrees | Line of action: the spine curved (+ curls forward, − arches back) |
| `headTilt` | degrees | Head tilt |
| `leftShoulder` | degrees | Left upper arm: 0 hangs down, 90 straight out to its side, 180 straight up; in profile, forward is negative for the left arm |
| `rightShoulder` | degrees | Right upper arm: 0 hangs down, 90 straight out (forward, in profile), 180 straight up |
| `leftElbow` | degrees | Left elbow bend, added to the upper arm |
| `rightElbow` | degrees | Right elbow bend, added to the upper arm |
| `leftHip` | degrees | Left thigh: 0 straight down; in profile negative is forward |
| `rightHip` | degrees | Right thigh: 0 straight down; in profile positive is forward |
| `leftKnee` | degrees | Left knee bend (negative folds the shin back) |
| `rightKnee` | degrees | Right knee bend (positive folds the shin back) |
| `leftWrist` | degrees | Left wrist bend, added to the forearm |
| `rightWrist` | degrees | Right wrist bend, added to the forearm |
| `leftAnkle` | degrees | Left ankle: + points the toe down (tiptoe), − onto the heel |
| `rightAnkle` | degrees | Right ankle: + points the toe down (tiptoe), − onto the heel |
| `leftFootOut` | -1..1 | Left foot turned out (seen from the front): 0 natural, 1 sideways, negative turned in |
| `rightFootOut` | -1..1 | Right foot turned out (seen from the front): 0 natural, 1 sideways, negative turned in |
| `mouth` | 0..1 | Mouth open: 0 closed, 1 wide open |
| `smile` | -1..1 | −1 frown, 0 flat, 1 smile |
| `mouthWidth` | factor | Mouth width: 1 normal, 0.5 pursed, 1.5 wide |
| `blink` | 0..1 | Eyes closed by a blink: 0 open, 1 shut |
| `leftEye` | factor | Left eye openness: 0 shut, 1 normal, 1.6 wide |
| `rightEye` | factor | Right eye openness: 0 shut, 1 normal, 1.6 wide |
| `leftBrow` | -1..1 | Left eyebrow: −1 lowered, 0 rest, 1 raised |
| `rightBrow` | -1..1 | Right eyebrow: −1 lowered, 0 rest, 1 raised |
| `browTilt` | -1..1 | Eyebrow slant: −1 angry, 1 worried |
| `lookX` | -1..1 | Eyes look across: + the way it faces |
| `lookY` | -1..1 | Eyes look down (+) or up (−) |
| `stretch` | factor | Squash and stretch: 1 normal, above taller (a jump), below squashed (a landing) |
| `turn` | 0..1 | 0 front-on, 1 in profile, turned the way it faces |
| `sit` | 0..1 | 0 standing, 1 seated |
| `spin` | degrees | Whole body turned about the hips: + rolls forward (a front flip), 360 a full turn |
| `rise` | × height | Lift off the ground, as a fraction of its height (the arc of a jump) |

### Other props

| Prop | Unit | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `walk` | strides | Walk-cycle phase, in strides: animate 0 → n for n strides |
| `walking` | 0..1 | How much of the walk cycle is applied (0 standing) |
| `gait` | string | How it walks: a gait name (walk, bouncy, doubleBounce, sneak, strut, tired, run, shove); a string track switches it |
| `talk` | 0..1 | How much the mouth chatters |
| `rubber` | 0..1 | Limbs from jointed (0) to rubber hose (1) |
| `facing` | ±1 | Which way it faces: 1 right, −1 left (key the flip while turn is near 0) |
| `beat` | beats | Beats into its dance (with a dance) |
| `dancing` | 0..1 | How much of the dance is applied |

With `style.hands`, each hand has `hand.left.<field>` / `hand.right.<field>` props: `thumb.curl`, `thumb.across`, `index.curl`, `middle.curl`, `ring.curl`, `pinky.curl`, `spread`, `turn`, `bend`, `tilt`, `roll`.

**Poses** (a beat's `do`, or a pose key): `rest`, `wave`, `cheer`, `shrug`, `point`, `think`, `handsOnHips`, `sad`, `surprised`, `crouch`, `sit`, `jump`, `duck`, `lie`, `sideSplit`, `frontSplit`.

**Expressions** (a beat's `mood`): `neutral`, `happy`, `joyful`, `sad`, `crying`, `surprised`, `shocked`, `angry`, `furious`, `worried`, `scared`, `confused`, `skeptical`, `thinking`, `sleepy`, `disgusted`, `smug`, `wink`.

**Gags** (ms): `take` (1260), `doubleTake` (1560), `windUp` (700), `land` (460), `tremble` (755), `deflate` (900).

**Gaits**: `walk`, `bouncy`, `doubleBounce`, `sneak`, `strut`, `tired`, `run`, `shove`. **Acting styles** (`style`): `full`, `snappy`, `limited`, `none`.

### Beat scripts

`scriptTracks(target, beats, { from, ground, height, facing, style })`. A beat has these fields only: `do`, `at`, `for`, `to`, `toward`, `mood`, `say`, `pose`, `target`, `onto`. Times are ms; `to` and `target` are scene px; `onto` is a floor's scene y.

| `do` | Needs | What happens |
|---|---|---|
| `walk` | `to` | Walks to `to` in the walk gait. |
| `bouncy` | `to` | Walks to `to` in the bouncy gait. |
| `doubleBounce` | `to` | Walks to `to` in the doubleBounce gait. |
| `sneak` | `to` | Walks to `to` in the sneak gait. |
| `strut` | `to` | Walks to `to` in the strut gait. |
| `tired` | `to` | Walks to `to` in the tired gait. |
| `run` | `to` | Walks to `to` in the run gait. |
| `shove` | `to` | Walks to `to` in the shove gait. |
| `rest` |  | Moves into the rest pose and holds it (`for` ms). |
| `wave` |  | Moves into the wave pose and holds it (`for` ms). |
| `cheer` |  | Moves into the cheer pose and holds it (`for` ms). |
| `shrug` |  | Moves into the shrug pose and holds it (`for` ms). |
| `point` |  | Moves into the point pose and holds it (`for` ms). |
| `think` |  | Moves into the think pose and holds it (`for` ms). |
| `handsOnHips` |  | Moves into the handsOnHips pose and holds it (`for` ms). |
| `sad` |  | Moves into the sad pose and holds it (`for` ms). |
| `surprised` |  | Moves into the surprised pose and holds it (`for` ms). |
| `crouch` |  | Moves into the crouch pose and holds it (`for` ms). |
| `sit` |  | Moves into the sit pose and holds it (`for` ms). |
| `jump` |  | Moves into the jump pose and holds it (`for` ms). |
| `duck` |  | Moves into the duck pose and holds it (`for` ms). |
| `lie` |  | Moves into the lie pose and holds it (`for` ms). |
| `sideSplit` |  | Moves into the sideSplit pose and holds it (`for` ms). |
| `frontSplit` |  | Moves into the frontSplit pose and holds it (`for` ms). |
| `take` |  | The take gag (1260 ms). |
| `doubleTake` |  | The doubleTake gag (1560 ms). |
| `windUp` |  | The windUp gag (700 ms). |
| `land` |  | The land gag (460 ms). |
| `tremble` |  | The tremble gag (755 ms). |
| `deflate` |  | The deflate gag (900 ms). |
| `look` |  | Turns the head and eyes toward a scene x, `viewer`, `ahead` or `back`. |
| `face` |  | Turns the whole figure toward a scene x (turning round if needed), `viewer`, `ahead` or `back`. |
| `say` | `say` | Lip-syncs the `say` line with small nods; the beat lasts as long as the line. |
| `hold` |  | Holds the pose (the acting pass drifts long holds). |
| `stand` |  | Back to its resting stance (a character’s own, else the rest pose), keeping the way it is turned. |
| `go` | `to` | Walks to `to` in its own gait (a character’s, else walk). |
| `zip` | `to` | The cartoon exit: winds up, wheels its legs in place, then shoots off to `to`, leaving dust. |
| `leap` |  | Crouches, springs, arcs and lands squashed at `to`, on the floor `onto` (a scene y). |
| `swipe` |  | Winds an arm up, then slides along the target with the arm out so the hand crosses it edge to edge. |
| `grab` | `target` | Steps to where its arm reaches the target (crouching for low things), takes it and lifts it overhead. |
| `throw` |  | Winds the arm back and throws forward and up toward `to` (or the target); `release` is when it lets go. |
| `kick` | `target` | Steps to a leg’s length from the target, draws the leg back and kicks through it. |
| `put` | `target` | Steps to where its arm reaches the spot and sets the thing down there. |
| `write` | `target` | Reaches a pen to the spot and writes along it left to right (moving along when it is wide). |
| `push` | `target`, `to` | Sets both hands on the target’s near side and walks it along until its centre is at `to`. |

Beats that touch something report `contact` (and `release`) times in `result.beats[i]`; key the thing they touch to those.

**Dances** (`dancer(style, { move })`): `disco` (point, roll, bump); `hipHop` (bounce, runningMan, armWave); `breaking` (toprock, kick, freeze); `jazz` (jazzHands, kickBallChange, splitDrop, jazzSquare); `kpop` (pointCombo, heart, isolations); `bollywood` (lightBulb, thumka, flick); `bhangra` (basic, dhamaal); `bharatanatyam` (tatta, natta, alapadma); `charleston` (basic, twist, kneeCross); `tap` (shuffleBallChange, timeStep, heelToe, crampRoll); `popping` (sideGlide, moonwalk, forwardGlide, toeStand).

**Flips**: `frontFlip` (Front flip (tuck)), `backFlip` (Back flip (tuck)), `layout` (Back layout (straight body)), `scissorFlip` (Scissor flip), `sideFlip` (Side flip (tuck)), `cartwheel` (Cartwheel), `splitLeap` (Split leap (grand jeté)), `toeTouch` (Toe touch (straddle jump)), `backHandspring` (Back handspring).

**Hand shapes**: `relaxed`, `open`, `spread`, `flat`, `fist`, `point`, `thumbsUp`, `peace`, `ok`, `pinch`, `cupped`, `wave`, `pencilGrip`, `hold`. **Mudras**: `pataka`, `tripataka`, `alapadma`, `mushti`, `shikhara`, `hamsasya`, `katakamukha`.

### Your own actions, gaits and personas

Nothing is registered globally: pass your definitions where they are used.

- `defineAction({ summary, needs?, steps: (from, beat) => [{ after, pose, easing? }] })`: a new action written as timed pose steps from the current pose, like a gag
- `defineAction({ summary, needs?, beats: (beat) => [beats] })`: a new action built from other beats (which may be custom too)
- `defineGait({ swing, knee, arm, elbow, lean, cycle?, … })`: a new gait (the Gait fields in degrees; cycle is ms per two steps)
- `scriptTracks(id, beats, { actions, gaits })`: beats may then use those names; checkBeats(beats, { actions, gaits }) knows them
- `stickFigureTarget({ …, cast: { actions, gaits } })`: a figure that draws the gaits and lists the actions in describeTarget
- `persona({ name, summary?, height?, look?, acting?, gait?, mood?, stance?, energy?, actions?, gaits? })`: a character’s look, acting style and habits: .figure({ x, y }), .script(id, beats, { from, ground }), .check(beats), .handPath(…), .describe(); `go` walks in its gait, `stand` returns to its stance and face

## Props (everyday objects with behaviours)

A prop is a 3D rig of simple parts drawn with the characters’ pens (clean, pencil, silhouette), so it turns toward the camera (`turn`), and its beats go through the same acting pass (anticipation, overshoot, overlap; `exaggeration` scales them).

- `car() · truck() · bus() · tractor() · cart() · trainCar() · bike() · motorbike()`: wheeled vehicles (vehicle(spec) makes your own)
- `tree() · house()`: environment (tree(spec), house(spec))
- `helicopter() · airplane()`: aircraft
- `horse() · dog() · cat() · cow()`: animals (quadruped(spec) makes your own): gaits with footfall patterns keyed in step with the distance, sit, jump, their calls, species actions
- `songbird() · crow() · chicken()`: birds (bird(spec) makes your own): hop, walk, peck, flap, fly and land (a chicken flutters), their calls; wings fold and beat in rhythm
- `{ kind: 'prop', prop: 'car', position, rotation, values } with loadScene3D(scene, { kinds: [characterObjects, propObjects] })`: props in 3D scenes, by preset name, seen in perspective by the scene camera; controls are tracks on the object
- `characterScript3D(id, beats, { scene, position?, heading?, height?, pose? })`: a v2 character in a 3D scene in world metres: gaits to [x, z] or through points (its walk phase keyed with the distance), face, hold, pose, gag; checkCharacterBeats3D checks the beats
- `propRide3D({ prop, propId, propTracks, scene, placement, anchor, riderId, pose, start, end, mount?, dismount? })`: a character riding a prop in a 3D scene: hips on a seat anchor (saddle, seat) as it moves, hopping on and off; RIDING_POSES.astride / .seated
- `propScript3D(id, prop, beats, { scene, position?, heading?, values? })`: props scripted in world metres for 3D scenes: moves to [x, z] or through points (wheels and strides keyed with the distance), face, hold, and their actions; checkPropBeats3D checks the beats
- `propPreset(name, options?)`: a prop preset by name (did-you-mean on a wrong one)
- `propTarget({ …, style: 'stick' })`: line art to go with stick figures: tubes as single strokes, shapes outlined over paper
- `propTow({ leader, leaderId, leaderTracks, hitch, towed, towedId, anchor, start, end })`: a prop towed by another (a cart behind a horse): turns with it, its wheels roll exactly
- `propTarget({ x, y, prop, scale?, values?, look?, ink? })`: a canvas target that draws a prop (x, y: its middle on the ground; scale px per metre, default 60)
- `propScript(id, prop, beats, { from, ground, scale, style?, exaggeration?, start? })`: beats → acted tracks, with contact times and effect cues; checkPropBeats(beats, prop) checks them
- `drawProp(ctx, target, frame, id, { rider? })`: draw it as it is in a frame (a rider is drawn between its far and near parts)
- `propAt(target, frame, id).anchor(name)`: where an anchor (seat, door, chimney…) is, in scene px
- `propRide({ prop, propId, propTracks, anchor, figure, figureId, start, end, offset? })`: a figure carried at an anchor, turning with the prop; spliceTracks() puts it into the figure’s tracks
- `drawPropEffects(ctx, effects, time)`: dust, exhaust, skid marks, honk lines, leaves, smoke

Prop beat fields: `do`, `at`, `for`, `to`, `toward`, `speed`, `open`, `on`, `height`, `wind`. Every prop has the controls `turn`, `tilt`, `pitch`, `roll`, `squash`, `lift`, `lean`, `size` and the actions `hold`, `turn`, `pop`, `vanish`.

| Preset | Family | Actions (needs) | Controls | Anchors |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `car()` | vehicle | `drive` (to), `brake` (to), `bump`, `honk`, `door` (open), `lights` (on) | `wheelSpin`, `door`, `lights`, `antenna` | seat, front, back, roof, door |
| `truck()` | vehicle | `drive` (to), `brake` (to), `bump`, `honk`, `door` (open), `lights` (on) | `wheelSpin`, `door`, `lights` | seat, front, back, roof, door |
| `bus()` | vehicle | `drive` (to), `brake` (to), `bump`, `honk`, `door` (open), `lights` (on) | `wheelSpin`, `door`, `lights` | seat, front, back, roof, door |
| `tractor()` | vehicle | `drive` (to), `brake` (to), `bump`, `honk`, `lights` (on) | `wheelSpin`, `lights` | seat, front, back, roof |
| `cart()` | vehicle | `drive` (to), `brake` (to), `bump`, `honk` | `wheelSpin` | seat, front, back, roof, shafts |
| `trainCar()` | vehicle | `drive` (to), `brake` (to), `bump`, `honk`, `lights` (on) | `wheelSpin`, `lights` | seat, front, back, roof |
| `bike()` | vehicle | `drive` (to), `brake` (to), `bump`, `honk` | `wheelSpin` | seat, front, back, roof |
| `motorbike()` | vehicle | `drive` (to), `brake` (to), `bump`, `honk`, `lights` (on) | `wheelSpin`, `lights` | seat, front, back, roof |
| `tree()` | plant | `sway`, `shake`, `shedLeaves` | `sway`, `canopySway` | canopy, top, base, branch |
| `house()` | building | `door` (open), `lights` (on), `shake`, `smoke` | `door`, `lights` | door, doorstep, ridge, chimney |
| `helicopter()` | aircraft | `takeOff`, `fly` (to), `hover`, `land` | `rotor`, `blur` | seat, door, rotor, skids, hook |
| `airplane()` | aircraft | `takeOff` (to), `fly` (to), `loop`, `land` (to) | `rotor`, `blur` | seat, nose, tail, wingtip |
| `horse()` | animal | `walk` (to), `trot` (to), `canter` (to), `gallop` (to), `neigh`, `sit`, `jump`, `nod`, `swish`, `graze`, `rear`, `buck` | `walk`, `walking`, `gait`, `neck`, `tail`, `wag`, `fl.swing`, `fl.knee`, `fl.ankle`, `fr.swing`, `fr.knee`, `fr.ankle`, `hl.swing`, `hl.knee`, `hl.ankle`, `hr.swing`, `hr.knee`, `hr.ankle` | back, head, mouth, front, hitch, saddle |
| `dog()` | animal | `walk` (to), `trot` (to), `run` (to), `gallop` (to), `bark`, `sit`, `jump`, `nod`, `swish`, `wag`, `sniff` | `walk`, `walking`, `gait`, `neck`, `tail`, `wag`, `fl.swing`, `fl.knee`, `fl.ankle`, `fr.swing`, `fr.knee`, `fr.ankle`, `hl.swing`, `hl.knee`, `hl.ankle`, `hr.swing`, `hr.knee`, `hr.ankle` | back, head, mouth, front, leash |
| `cat()` | animal | `walk` (to), `trot` (to), `run` (to), `gallop` (to), `meow`, `sit`, `jump`, `nod`, `swish`, `arch`, `pounce` (to) | `walk`, `walking`, `gait`, `neck`, `tail`, `wag`, `fl.swing`, `fl.knee`, `fl.ankle`, `fr.swing`, `fr.knee`, `fr.ankle`, `hl.swing`, `hl.knee`, `hl.ankle`, `hr.swing`, `hr.knee`, `hr.ankle` | back, head, mouth, front |
| `cow()` | animal | `walk` (to), `trot` (to), `moo`, `sit`, `jump`, `nod`, `swish`, `graze` | `walk`, `walking`, `gait`, `neck`, `tail`, `wag`, `fl.swing`, `fl.knee`, `fl.ankle`, `fr.swing`, `fr.knee`, `fr.ankle`, `hl.swing`, `hl.knee`, `hl.ankle`, `hr.swing`, `hr.knee`, `hr.ankle` | back, head, mouth, front |
| `songbird()` | bird | `hop` (to), `walk` (to), `peck`, `flap`, `tweet`, `fly` (to), `land` | `spread`, `flap`, `wingbeat`, `flapping`, `peck`, `step`, `stepping`, `leg.left`, `leg.right` | beak, head, back, feet |
| `crow()` | bird | `hop` (to), `walk` (to), `peck`, `flap`, `caw`, `fly` (to), `land` | `spread`, `flap`, `wingbeat`, `flapping`, `peck`, `step`, `stepping`, `leg.left`, `leg.right` | beak, head, back, feet |
| `chicken()` | bird | `hop` (to), `walk` (to), `peck`, `flap`, `cluck`, `flutter` | `spread`, `flap`, `wingbeat`, `flapping`, `peck`, `step`, `stepping`, `leg.left`, `leg.right` | beak, head, back, feet |

## Character (v2 human)

Poses: `rest`, `wave`, `cheer`, `point`, `handsOnHips`, `think`, `shrug`, `sit`, `kneel`, `crouch`, `crawl`, `lieDown`. Expressions: `neutral`, `happy`, `joyful`, `sad`, `crying`, `surprised`, `shocked`, `angry`, `furious`, `worried`, `scared`, `confused`, `skeptical`, `thinking`, `sleepy`, `disgusted`, `smug`, `wink`. Gags: `take`, `doubleTake`, `windUp`, `land`, `tremble`, `deflate`.

## Code panel

`codePanel({ code, language, x, y, fontSize?, lineHeight?, width? })`: a code listing as a scene object. Languages: `go`, `rust`, `csharp`, `javascript`, `typescript`, `python`, `plain`. Remove styles: `wipe`, `fly`, `blur`.

- `line(n, time?)`: line n’s text box { x, y, left, right, top, bottom, width, height }: stand on top, point at x, y
- `token(n, text, occurrence?, time?)`: a word on a line
- `spot(n, column, width?, time?)`: a place in a line, for put and write
- `landing(piece, n, column)`: where a dropped piece will land
- `box`: the whole panel

- `highlight(n | n[], { at, duration?, on? })`: tint lines (on: false clears)
- `strike(n | n[], { at, duration? })`: strike lines through, left to right
- `remove(n | n[], { at, duration?, style?`: wipe | fly | blur, from?: left | right, close? }): take lines away; the lines below close the gap
- `type(n, { at, duration? })`: type in a line given in `hidden`
- `piece(n, text, occurrence?)`: make a word a piece that can come loose (returns it, with its home box)
- `follow(piece, path)`: carry a piece along timed points (handPath() gives a hand’s)
- `fling(piece, { at, velocity?, spin?, gravity?, duration? })`: throw or kick a piece away on a spinning arc
- `move(piece, { at, to`: { x, y }, duration?, easing? }): move a piece’s centre to a point
- `write(piece, text, { at, duration? })`: type new text into a piece’s place
- `insert(n, column, text, { at, duration? })`: type new text into a line; the line makes room
- `drop(piece, n, column, { at, duration? })`: put a piece into a line (into its own line it slides, the text closing behind it)
- `ride(tracks, figureId, { ground })`: a figure’s tracks with it carried by the line it stands on

## Surfaces

Scene objects figures act on. Places are named `kind:args`: `surface.anchor(name)` gives the box there (stand on `top`, point at `x`, `y`; pass it as a beat `target`), `surface.piece(name)` makes the part there come loose, and `surface.edit(name, anchor, options)` changes the surface at a time (`at`, ms).

Beats name places and say what surfaces do in answer (`surfaceScript`):

- `surfaceScript(figureId, { name: surface }, beats, options)`: compiles beats that act on surfaces: returns the script result with `tracks` (the figure’s, ridden, then every surface’s, keyed by its name) and `figureTracks`; options are scriptTracks’ plus `figureStyle` (for carry) and `ride` (default true)
- `checkSurfaceBeats(beats, surfaces, cast?)`: every problem checkBeats finds, plus unknown surfaces, places, edits and moments, with suggestions
- `{ surface, anchor }`: a named place, where a beat takes `target` (its box), `to` (its centre x) or `onto` (its top); as laid out, before any edit moves it
- `then: { surface, edit, anchor, at?, until?, …options }`: what the surface does in answer to the beat (or a list of them): one of its edits, or `carry` (the piece follows the hand until `until`); the other fields are the edit’s options
- `at`: a moment of the beat: start, contact, release, end (default contact, or start when the beat has none); not ms
- `until`: a moment of this beat, or { beat: index, at? } of a later one; sets the edit’s duration (carry needs it)

### code

`codePanel({ code, language?, x, y, fontSize?, lineHeight?, width?, hidden? })`

Anchors:
- `box`: the whole panel
- `line:N`: line N’s text (lines count from 1): stand on top, point at x, y, swipe left to right
- `token:N:TEXT`: the first TEXT on line N (token:N#K:TEXT for the Kth): a word, which can come loose as a piece
- `spot:N:C`: a place in line N before column C (0 is before its first character); spot:N:C:W is W characters wide. Aim a put or a write here

Edits:
- `highlight`: line anchors; { at, duration?, on? }: tint lines (on: false clears)
- `strike`: line anchors; { at, duration? }: strike lines through, left to right
- `remove`: line anchors; { at, duration?, style?: wipe | fly | blur, from?: left | right, close? }: take lines away; the lines below close the gap
- `type`: line anchors given in `hidden`; { at, duration? }: type them in
- `insert`: a spot; { at, text, duration? }: type new text into the line there; the line makes room
- `write`: a token; { at, text, duration? }: write new text into the word’s place
- `drop`: a token; { at, into: a spot, duration? }: put the word into a line there
- `move`: a token; { at, to: an anchor name or { x, y }, duration? }: move the word there
- `fling`: a token; { at, velocity?, spin?, gravity?, duration? }: throw or kick the word away on a spinning arc

### board

`whiteboard({ x, y, width, height, theme?: whiteboard | chalkboard, fontSize?, items: [{ id, text, at: [x, y], size?, color?, hidden? } | { id, mark: circle | box | underline | arrow, around? | from?, to?, color?, hidden? }] })`

Anchors:
- `box`: the whole board
- `text:ID`: a text item: write along it from left to right, point at it
- `term:ID:TEXT`: the first TEXT in text ID (term:ID#K:TEXT for the Kth): a term, which can come loose as a piece
- `mark:ID`: a mark (circle, box, underline or arrow)

Edits:
- `write`: text anchors given `hidden`; { at, duration? }: write them in by hand. Or a term; { at, text, duration? }: write new text in its place (move or erase the term first)
- `draw`: mark anchors given `hidden`; { at, duration? }: draw them in
- `erase`: text, term or mark anchors; { at, duration? }: wipe them off
- `strike`: text or term anchors; { at, duration? }: cross them out
- `move`: a term; { at, to: an anchor name or { x, y }, duration? }: move the term there
- `fling`: a term; { at, velocity?, spin?, gravity?, duration? }: throw or knock the term off on a spinning arc

### chart

`chart({ x, y, width, height, kind: bar | line, data: [{ id, label?, value, hidden? }], max?, title?, theme?: light | dark, decimals?, prefix?, suffix?, values? })`

Anchors:
- `box`: the whole chart
- `bar:ID`: a bar (bar charts), as it stands at the time: stand on its top (it carries a figure as it grows), point at it
- `point:ID`: a point on the line (line charts), as it stands at the time
- `label:ID`: its label under the axis
- `value:ID`: its value label, above it

Edits:
- `set`: bar or point anchors; { at, value, duration? }: animate to a new value; its value label counts along
- `show`: bar or point anchors given `hidden`; { at, duration?, on? }: grow a bar in from the axis, or draw the line out to a point (on: false takes it back)
- `highlight`: bar or point anchors; { at, duration?, on? }: colour it out (on: false clears)

## Camera shots (`cameraTracks(shots, { stage })`)

- **frame**: `{ at, duration?, easing?, frame: { focus?: { x, y }, scale?, rotate? } }: push in, pull out, or cut (duration 0)`
- **shake**: `{ at, duration, shake: { strength?, frequency?, roll?, seed? } }`
- **follow**: `{ at, until, follow: { x: <the subject’s x keyframes>, lead?, y?, lag?, scale? } }: keeps a subject centred`

## Teaching (`@algorisys/tinyfly/teach`)

- `lesson({ id })`: steps as timeline JSON: to, set, together, wait, marker (with pause, question, captions)
- `cells, pointer, stack, queue, table, pipeline`: diagram primitives (SVG markup + step helpers)
- `figure({ width, height, children })`: the SVG holding the pieces

## Command line

- `tinyfly capabilities [--json]`: this catalog
- `tinyfly check <beats.json>`: check a beat script (names, fields) with suggestions
- `tinyfly validate <timeline.json> [--markup file]`: check a timeline against its markup
- `tinyfly render <timeline.json> <markup> [--at …]`: a frame as static markup
- `tinyfly video <scene.mjs> [--stills dir --times …]`: MP4, or PNG stills to look at
